messages.content: You are a precise biomedical information extraction assistant. Follow the requested output format exactly and never add explanations.

Find duplicate entities for the item and an alias that best represents the duplicates. Duplicates are those that are the same in meaning, such as with variation in tense, plural form, stem form, case, abbreviation, shorthand. Return an empty list if there are none.

item: "wash your hands after using Zuplenz"
set: ["wash your hands after using Zuplenz", "wash hands before use", "Zuplenz", "cold hands and feet", "swelling in the hands or feet", "swelling in legs, feet, or hands", "muscle spasms in hands and feet", "ask your doctor how to safely stop using", "ask your doctor if you can keep using this medicine after 6 months of daily use", "do not stop using without first asking your doctor", "tell your doctor if you have blood circulation problems in the hands or feet", "ask your doctor about using a non-hormonal birth control", "call your doctor if your hives do not improve after 3 days", "call your doctor at once if you have wheezing, choking, or other breathing problems after using this medicine", "blood circulation problems in the hands or feet", "cold hands and feet in 1% of people"]

Respond with a JSON object with exactly these fields:
  "duplicates": list of exact matches to items in the entities set that are duplicates of the item
  "alias": best entity name to represent the duplicates, ideally from the entities set
